_doc: What each offer includes, by Revenue OS function (the ids in agents.json). tools/tier.py turns a tier into the routines to create and the worker jobs to switch on. `core` (the lead role and the data lane) runs on every tier and is not listed. Prices are the public price points; the percentage is given at intake and is never in this pack.

revenue-partnerships.name: Revenue Partnerships 3.0
revenue-partnerships.price: $2,000 up front, plus a percentage of the revenue that comes from the partnerships
revenue-partnerships.what: We build the partnership outreach, then manage the partnerships and the outreach for you.

revenue-os.name: Revenue OS
revenue-os.what: Everything in Revenue Partnerships 3.0, plus cold leads, Lead Radar, and AEO and SEO.

coaching.name: Coaching and training
coaching.what: Optional, on either tier. Without it, it is a straight revenue partnership.

worker_jobs._doc: Which function each worker job serves; core jobs run on every tier.
